ache.title: A trailer is an ad with nicer music
ache.note: Nero watches Ellen’s trailer with you and gushes about the art style. That’s the point of a trailer: make one character feel like the reason to come back and spend. Enjoy the art all you want. Just remember a trailer is the start of a sales pitch for a banner.
watch: a character trailer as a banner ad
art love turning into pull plans
ache.tip: Watch trailers like movie ads: fun to see, no ticket required.
